(module scope)

Email → Gravatar hash per Gravatar's spec: trim + lowercase, SHA-256, hex string. crypto.subtle keeps the hash on the browser's crypto engine — no hashing code or dependency needed. Each byte is hex-encoded and zero-padded so the digest renders as the canonical 64-char string.

  • @param email Raw email input (any casing/whitespace).
  • @returns The lowercase 64-char hex SHA-256 digest.
